Kettle & Co.
Menu Hours

Coffee worth walking for.

Slow-roasted beans, bread baked at dawn, and a corner table with your name on it.

See the menu

On the board today

Everything is made here, in small batches. The board changes when the season does.

  • Flat white

    A double shot of our house roast, poured over silk-steamed milk.

  • Cardamom bun

    Laminated at midnight, baked at six, gone by ten if you are slow.

  • Breakfast plate

    Eggs, sourdough and whatever the market had that looked good.

When we are open

Every day from 7am. The kitchen closes at 3pm, the coffee machine an hour after that.
